cues: The courtyard becomes a marketplace, and soldiers have to break up the mob.
Elisenda, aching from sweeping up the litter, has an idea: fence the yard and charge five cents to see the angel.
Pilgrims come from far away: a woman who has counted her heartbeats since childhood and run out of numbers, a man kept awake by the noise of the stars.
Within a week the house is crammed with money.
